title: The Lantern
logline: A neighbourhood spends weeks building a great Vesak lantern of bamboo and paper, lights it for a few nights, then takes it apart.

object.note: Object 1 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: From a procession's fire to a neighbourhood's paper lights: something built with great care, seen for a few nights, then taken apart.

thread_out.thread: As the lantern comes down, the first thing found beneath the names is wanting: the colours of lantern paper give way to cloth unfolded bolt after bolt, and something wanted badly.
